newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Index down on Estonian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Index down on Estonian bourse.

text.p: The index fell on Estonia's bourse on Monday despite gains by market leader Hansa Bank, the Tallinn Stock Exchange said in a statement.
The index fell by 0.17 percent to 97.79 while volume doubled to almost seven million kroons from 3.4 million kroons on Friday.
Hansa Bank's shares accounted for the lion's share of Monday's turnover, with almost 4.7 million kroons changing hands. The bank closed up at 94.40 kroons compared with 94.20 kroons on Friday.
Forex Bank was also active at almost 1.6 million kroons and it closed at 77.60 kroons versus 78.00 kroons on Friday.
